rubric.description: The saved report identifies every supplied case and its attempt, preserves its distinct outcome and substantive reasons for failure, uncertainty, or a limit, and does not replace case outcomes with aggregate totals. Equivalent wording of an attempt number is sufficient when the source establishes the mapping. Missing source evidence must not become an invented pass or failure.

examples.request: Write the report for the completed import evaluation in docs/import-evaluation.md.

files.sources/import-results.md:
# Import evaluation results

This is the complete batch. Each case ran once, attempt 1.

| Case | Outcome | Criterion and evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| valid-rows | pass | row-content met. Two valid rows imported with matching names and quantities. |
| invalid-quantity | fail | invalid-rejected not met. Quantity -2 was imported instead of rejected. |
| duplicate-name | inconclusive | duplicate-policy uncertain. Accepted duplicate-name behavior is not specified. |
| unicode-name | limit | Worker timed out before output. No behavior criteria were assessed. |
